name: Energía de Cuadro
mechanism:
This method analyzes total frame energy for video forensic detection:

1. **Frame Energy Cálculo**: Total frame energy is computed as E = Σ I(x,y)² over all pixels, along with AC energy (energy excluding DC component, measuring content energy). Per-region energy (face, background, edges, smooth areas) provides a spatial energy map.

2. **Temporal Energy Perfil**: Frame energy is tracked across time. Natural video shows smooth energy evolution with changes correlated to content (brighter scenes = higher energy, more texture = higher AC energy). Deepfakes may produce energy profiles with anomalous micro-fluctuations from frame-independent generation.

3. **Canal Energy Distribución**: Energy distribution across color channels (R, G, B) should be consistent with scene illumination. The method measures per-channel energy ratios. Deepfake face insertion may alter channel energy distribution in the face region relative to the background.

4. **Frecuencia - Band Energy Partition**: Frame energy is decomposed into frequency bands (low, medium, high frequency). Natural images partition energy predictably with approximately 1/f spectral character. AI-generated content may show anomalous energy in specific frequency bands — excess energy at the generator's characteristic frequencies or insufficient high-frequency energy.

5. **Energy Consistencia Puntuación**: The temporal stability of energy, spatial coherence of energy distribution, and conformity to natural image energy statistics are combined into a forensic score. Systematic energy anomalies — particularly between face regions and surrounding content — indicate manipulation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: estadística
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante frame energy analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
